text:
incident-bot: PAGERS: Elevated 5xx rate observed on api-gateway-prod (edge) starting ~2026-03-15T09:12:03Z. Alert: GW-502-504-EDGE-ALERT-9923. Current error rate: ~12% across US-EAST-1; increased tail latencies. Paging on-call.

maria: on it — digging into top hosts. first glance: fanout to internal proxy returning 502s, not pure network flap.

sam: thanks. do we know which routes are hottest? any customer-facing endpoints?

maria: POST /v1/stream and /v1/generate show highest error budget burn. Affected tenants mostly high-concurrency integrations.

leigh: seeing retries increasing, some clients are spiking concurrency after retries. Suggest disabling retries at the ingress for now.

ashley: confirmed region breakdown: us-east-1 11.9% 5xx, eu-west-1 2.1%, us-west-2 0.8%. Looks localized to east edge POPs.

maria: logs snippet from edge proxy (truncated):

```
[09:13:18] EDGE -> PROXY id=abc123 status=502 backend=proxy-pool-12 upstream_err=connection-reset
[09:13:19] EDGE -> PROXY id=abc124 status=502 backend=proxy-pool-07 upstream_err=timeout
[09:13:20] PROXY -> BACKEND id=abc125 status=200 route=/health
```

sam: that pattern suggests proxy pool exhaustion or a misbehaving new proxy instance. Any deploys around 09:10? ops-bot, recent deploys?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: release/infra/proxy-autoscale v2.14 promoted at 2026-03-15T09:08:42Z to us-east-1 (canary -> 100%).

maria: that matches. rollback flagged as option. Could we throttle traffic to the new proxy pool or switch routing to previous pool?

leigh: can we temporarily enable route-level circuit breaker for high-fanout POSTs and return 429s instead of cascading 502s? 429s are safer and callers already retry/backoff.

sam: +1. Action items: 1) disable ingress retries, 2) flip weight away from release/infra/proxy-autoscale in us-east, 3) enable circuit-breaker on POST /v1/*, 4) monitor error rate. Who can do 2 and 3?

maria: I'll handle 2 (traffic shift). Doing weight shift now: `kubectl patch svc api-edge --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/weights/proxy-autoscale","value":0}]'`

ashley: I'm on 3 (circuit breaker). Applying temporary route config: `edge-config set-cb --route "/v1/*" --threshold 10 --interval 10s --action 429`

sam: leaving a note: disabling retries at the load balancer: `lbctl update --no-retry --scope ingress` (applying in 2m).

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation happening — sam acknowledged the page.

maria: traffic shift completed. Rolling weight from proxy-autoscale -> proxy-stable. Monitoring.

ashley: CB applied, ingress retries off. Expect about 60s for changes to take effect across POPs.

(1m) sam: early signal — 5xx rate dropping to ~6.4% in us-east, p95 down ~200ms. Still above baseline but improving.

leigh: can we sanity-check telemetry / logs for dropped connections from proxy-stable? want to ensure we're not accidentally routing to unhealthy nodes.

maria: checked health endpoints on proxy-stable; nodes healthy. The failing pool had increased fd usage and GC stalls in logs; likely regression in autoscale release.

sam: decision: keep traffic on proxy-stable, roll back release/infra/proxy-autoscale from us-east, and mark release as blocked until root cause. Can infra team confirm rollback?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling back release/infra/proxy-autoscale in us-east-1 to v2.13. Initiating rollback at 09:18:10Z.

ashley: post-rollback monitor shows 5xx ~1.6% and trending down. Customer impact: known intermittent failures for payment-processing and webhook-heavy tenants between 09:11-09:18 UTC.

sam: product-safety question — any long-lived customer sessions impacted or data loss?

maria: no evidence of data loss. Some idempotent POSTs might have been retried client-side leading to duplicate events; we're going to reach out to top 5 affected customers with mitigation notes.

leigh: recommended follow-ups: 1) mark release as blocked and run canary analysis, 2) add FD and GC metrics to release gating for proxy-autoscale, 3) create postmortem if customer impact > 1% of traffic or any SLA breach.

sam: I'm taking ownership of the postmortem. I'll coordinate with infra and SRE.

ashley: filing support ticket for customers affected: list prepared and first outreach draft in #customer-success.

maria: adding runbook entry: `edge->proxy pool rollback play` updated with this rollback step and the `lbctl` quick commands.

ops-bot: incident-bot: incident state -> mitigated (automated condition cleared).

sam: thanks team. I'll leave this thread open and update when postmortem draft is ready. For now: on-call sam (primary), maria (SRE), ashley (ops), leigh (infra). :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging at 2026-03-15T09:29:00Z.
